title: PheraCam
description: Real-time face recognition system using Edge AI. 1st Runner Up at HackLab Nigeria Hackathon.

details.tagline: Securing spaces with Edge AI and Real-time Facial Recognition.
details.problem: Traditional security cameras are passive recording devices that fail to prevent intrusion in real-time.
details.solution: PheraCam uses edge computing to process video feeds locally, distinguishing between 'Registered' family members and 'Unregistered' threats instantly (<150ms).

features.title: Major Win
features.desc: 1st Runner Up (2nd Place) at HackLab Nigeria Hackathon (₦500k Grant).

features.title: Latency
features.desc: Optimized response time to under 150ms using Edge AI.

features.title: Accuracy
features.desc: Achieved >95% recognition accuracy on test sets.

title: Amala Atlas
description: The Intelligent, Global Map for Amala Discovery. GDG Lagos' first open-source project.

details.tagline: Finding Home, One Amala Wrap at a Time.
details.problem: Finding authentic Amala spots is a quest relying on luck and guesswork, with no centralized data.
details.solution: An intelligent ecosystem featuring an Autonomous Discovery Agent that scrapes food blogs and a crowdsourced map for community verification.

features.title: Autonomous Agent
features.desc: Built a web scraper that scans global food blogs to auto-populate the map.

features.title: Open Source
features.desc: The first open-source project by Google Developer Group (GDG) Lagos.

features.title: Intelligent Geosearch
features.desc: Instantly converts scraped addresses into precise latitude/longitude coordinates.

title: Coffee_Break
description: A hybrid-work social platform helping remote teams bond. Winner at Hybrid Work Hackathon.

details.tagline: Bringing the 'Water Cooler' moments to remote teams.
details.problem: Working in a hybrid company can be isolating. Spontaneous social interactions are lost.
details.solution: A virtual break room that uses spatial audio and gamified icebreakers to connect colleagues.

features.title: Award Winner
features.desc: Recognized for Best Social Impact in Hybrid Work.

features.title: Spatial Audio
features.desc: Proximity-based voice chat for natural mingling.

title: Medity
description: Health information app bridging the gap for under-resourced regions during pandemics.

details.tagline: Taking data and info to the uttermost parts of the globe.
details.problem: Developing nations often lack centralized, accurate, and accessible information during global health crises.
details.solution: A lightweight, mobile-first application that aggregates real-time disease stats, news, and regional regulations.

features.title: Real-Time Data
features.desc: Centralized dashboard for COVID-19, Ebola, and Influenza statistics.

features.title: Mobile First
features.desc: Optimized for low-bandwidth environments common in developing regions.

title: TodoSay
description: Voice-activated productivity app designed for accessibility.

details.tagline: You tell it what you want, it does the rest.
details.problem: Traditional todo apps are difficult for users with motor disabilities or those experiencing typing fatigue.
details.solution: A hands-free productivity tool that uses the Web Speech API to parse voice commands into organized tasks.

features.title: Accessibility First
features.desc: Designed specifically for users who cannot type easily.

features.title: Voice Parsing
features.desc: Intelligently converts natural speech into actionable items.

title: Coeus
description: AI-powered quiz platform that generates questions from your notes to boost memory retention.

details.tagline: Your memories matter. Study smarter with AI.
details.problem: Creating flashcards and quizzes manually is time-consuming.
details.solution: Upload your notes, and Coeus uses NLP to generate active recall quizzes instantly.

features.title: Instant Generation
features.desc: Turn raw notes into quizzes in seconds.

features.title: Active Recall
features.desc: Proven study method automated by AI.

title: Flower Image Classifier
description: Deep learning model for image classification trained on 102 distinct flower categories.

details.tagline: Computer Vision model for botanical classification.
details.problem: Accurately classifying flora requires specialized botanical knowledge.
details.solution: A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on the Oxford Flowers 102 dataset using Transfer Learning (VGG19).

title: Cloud Warriors
description: Automated cloud infrastructure deployment using Terraform and Docker.

details.tagline: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for scalable deployments.
details.problem: Manual server provisioning is slow and error-prone.
